facts.text: The hotel is located along the Kamo River, often referred to as Kyoto's Seine River.
facts.excerpt: is located along the Kamo River, which flows through the elegant neighborhoods of Kyoto and is often referred to as "Kyoto's Seine River."

facts.text: The hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Gion, Higashiyama and Shijo Kawaramachi.
facts.excerpt: It is located within a 10-minute walk of Kyoto's popular tourist attractions including Gion, Higashiyama, and Shijo Kawaramachi.

facts.text: Kenninji Temple is a 7-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Access7 minutes walk from the hotel

facts.text: The design blends FAUCHON style in magenta, black and gold with nods to Kyoto, including black painted bamboo accents on the walls.
facts.excerpt: The new property is a masterful blend of FAUCHON style featuring magenta, black, and gold with a nod to our Kyoto location. There are black painted bamboo accents on the walls

facts.text: Sakura petals appear in many design elements, including the lobby ceiling lights and the fabrics in the guest rooms and suites.
facts.excerpt: Sakura petals incorporated in many design elements including on the lobby ceiling lights as well as fabrics in the guest rooms and suites

facts.text: Washi paper lines the wall above the headboards in the guest rooms, and the bedside lighting represents the French millefeuille pastry.
facts.excerpt: Washi paper (used in Origami) on the wall above the headboards in the guest rooms. Another design element is the beautiful bedside lighting which represents the French millefeuille pastry.

facts.text: Every room and suite has a FAUCHON Gourmet Bar, a reimagined minibar in a cabinet custom-crafted by Roche Bobois and designer Sacha Lakic.
facts.excerpt: Enclosed within the stunning cabinet custom-crafted for FAUCHON by French luxury manufacturer Roche Bobois and renowned designer Sacha Lakic

facts.text: The Gourmet Bar holds FAUCHON products including champagne and sweet and savory treats.
facts.excerpt: Resting behind the doors and within the cabinet drawers are the most delightful FAUCHON products including champagne and other sweet and savory FAUCHON branded treats.

facts.text: The Fauchon Suite has a separate living room, bedroom, bathroom and walk-in closet.
facts.excerpt: Featuring a separate living room, bedroom, bathroom, and walk-in closet, each artfully designed space comes together to create a stunning residence while in Kyoto.

facts.text: Suites are decorated in FAUCHON pink, white, black and gold on Japanese fabrics and textiles.
facts.excerpt: the decor features the mixture of FAUCHON’s pink, white, black, and gold on Japanese fabrics and textiles to symbolize FAUCHON Meets Kyoto.

facts.text: The Grand Cafe FAUCHON is on the top floor with a panoramic view of Higashiyama and serves casual French cuisine.
facts.excerpt: An impressive and stunning space on the top floor of FAUCHON L’Hotel Kyoto, The Grand Cafe FAUCHON invites diners to enjoy a rare panoramic view of Higashiyama.

facts.text: Teatime features a pink teapot, macarons and a tea blend, One Night In Kyoto, created especially for the hotel.
facts.excerpt: including a pink teapot and macarons along with a special tea blend, “One Night In Kyoto” (green tea with fruity notes of cherry, pear, and tangerine) created especially for the hotel.

facts.text: Le Bar FAUCHON serves FAUCHON signature tea cocktails and FAUCHON Champagne, with sunset views over Kyoto.
facts.excerpt: Le Bar FAUCHON is a wonderful spot to relax with FAUCHON’s signature tea cocktails, a La Delicieuse beer, fine wine, or a glass of FAUCHON Champagne.

facts.text: Le Spa FAUCHON is the world's first spa named after FAUCHON, in partnership with Credo International and KOS PARIS.
facts.excerpt: Here at Le Spa FAUCHON, the world’s first spa named after FAUCHON and introducing a new partnership to Japan with Credo International Co., Ltd. and KOS PARIS.

facts.text: The spa offers an optional Private Bath Ritual with a pink bathtub with rose petals floating on top.
facts.excerpt: Combine the best of French and Japanese healing treatments with our optional Private Bath Ritual. Open the door to the treatment room and see a pink bathtub with rose petals floating on top.

facts.text: Le Spa FAUCHON won the World Luxury Spa Award 2025.
facts.excerpt: “Le Spa Fauchon” Wins the World Luxury Spa Award 2025

facts.text: The hotel has a gym on the 2nd floor alongside reception.
facts.excerpt:

facts.text: There is no parking lot at the hotel; public transportation, a taxi or car service is recommended.
facts.excerpt: There is no parking lot at our hotel.

facts.text: The hotel is a 6-minute walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Station on the Keihan Line.
facts.excerpt: ■6-minute walk from Kiyomizu-Gojo Station on the Keihan Line

facts.text: The hotel offers exclusive private tours and curated experiences of Kyoto.
facts.excerpt: With exclusive private tours and curated experiences,

facts.text: A specially curated playlist mixes French and Japanese music.
facts.excerpt: Our specially curated playlist mixes French and Japanese music to present a new auditory experience.

facts.text: The street-level Patisserie and Boutique sells FAUCHON macarons and fruit-flavored teas imported directly from Paris.
facts.excerpt: This is the place to find FAUCHON’s incredible macarons and fruit-flavored teas which are imported directly from Paris and only available at this address.

facts.text: Auguste Fauchon opened his first gourmet food shop in Paris in 1886.
facts.excerpt: Auguste Fauchon opened his first gourmet food shop in Paris in 1886

facts.text: Higashiyama-view rooms look out on Kiyomizu-dera and the Higashiyama hills.
facts.excerpt: フォションホテル京都の東山ビューの客室からは世界遺産の清水寺と東山をご覧いただけます。
